input.body:
label: feature
file: src/exportUtils.ts

This is a request for new behaviour: add a TSV export format alongside the existing CSV and XLSX options. Currently `SUPPORTED_FORMATS` in src/exportUtils.ts only lists "csv" and "xlsx", which drives the format validation in src/api/reports.ts, the content-type mapping, and the writer dispatch in `renderExport`. Adding "tsv" would require a new writer (e.g. src/export/tsv.ts), updating SUPPORTED_FORMATS/content types in src/exportUtils.ts, wiring it into renderExport/reports.ts, the scheduler, and the ExportButton UI.
